Lived-In Face.name: Lived-In Face
Lived-In Face.description: The user settles into a borrowed form for the long haul. From any sample it holds for a full day and night through sleep, pain and shock, and the user picks up the person's walk, accent, handwriting and habits, so coworkers, neighbors and casual friends accept them; only a blood test, a tracking dog, a Quirk-suppressing effect or a question only the real person could answer exposes them. Strain: heavy.
